rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Trust Boundary Systems exposes read-only information and booking-request tools for their Vancouver-based board advisory and software engineering firm specializing in blockchain, AI, cryptography, stablecoins, and global payment rails. The server enables agents to access firm information and submit contact requests that are emailed to the site owner. Authentication is handled via OAuth on the trustboundarysystems.com authorization server.
